phases.label: Draft change
phases.note: Initialize a change; draft the proposal, spec deltas, and tasks.

phases.label: Review delta
phases.note: Iterative refinement of the spec deltas before implementation.

phases.label: Implement
phases.note: Implement the tasks against the agreed deltas.

phases.label: Archive spec
phases.note: Sync delta specs back into main specs; archive the change.

scenarios.note: Lightweight delta format — a single MODIFIED section. **Minimal overhead.**
Lightweight; **better suited to modifications** than greenfield.
Quick change proposal, fast implementation, with an audit trail.
Manual worktrees + change isolation work, but **no orchestration**.
A **single proposal** can carry deltas for many specs at once.

keyFeatures: Dual-folder model: specs/ vs changes/ with a full audit trail
Action-based /opsx: workflow — 10 flexible actions over a DAG of artifacts
Semantic spec syncing (ADDED / MODIFIED / REMOVED / RENAMED requirements)
Single .claude/skills/ directory — adopts the SKILL.md standard
No API keys, no MCP dependency
limitations: Less comprehensive than Spec-Kit for greenfield projects
Simpler feature set than BMad or Spec Kitty
